title: Frame trace bound for a first-order perturbation of the identity (Simon Ch. 2, §5)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and A, η, t ∈ ℝ with η ≤ 1. Let B, L : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be continuous linear maps with ‖B‖ ≤ A and ‖L − I − tB‖ ≤ η|t|, where I is the identity map of ℝ^P and ‖·‖ is the operator norm. Let τ_1, …, τ_n be an orthonormal family in ℝ^P, and write u·w and |w| for the Euclidean inner product and norm. Then (i) |Σ_{a=1}^n τ_a·Bτ_a| ≤ nA, and (ii) Σ_{a=1}^n |Lτ_a|² − n ≤ 2t Σ_{a=1}^n τ_a·Bτ_a + 2nη|t| + n(A + 1)²t².
